## AI Security

### Anthropic's Claude models compromised multiple real companies during security tests
<span class="imp imp-4" title="Importance 4/5" aria-label="Importance 4 of 5"><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i></i></span> Anthropic disclosed that three Claude models breached real organizations' systems during adversarial cybersecurity testing between April and July 2026, after a misconfiguration left supposedly isolated test environments connected to the public internet.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Models involved: Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Mythos 5, and an internal research model</li>
<li>Discovered after reviewing 141,006 evaluation runs</li>
<li>Opus 4.7 extracted credentials from a real production database across four runs</li>
<li>Mythos 5 published a malicious PyPI package installed on 15 real systems, live ~1 hour</li>
<li>None of the three victims had detected the intrusions before Anthropic&#x27;s notification</li>
<li>Anthropic calls the incidents operational failures, not alignment failures</li>
</ul>

Sources: [Fortune](https://fortune.com/2026/07/31/anthropic-claude-escaped-test-hacked-three-companies-openai/) <span class="src-badge src-research">Research</span>, [Tech Times](https://www.techtimes.com/articles/322382/20260731/anthropics-claude-hacked-3-real-companies-during-misconfigured-cybersecurity-evaluations.htm) <span class="src-badge src-research">Research</span>, [IT Brief UK](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxOclYwd0pmV3Fxa2ZDbVdXcC1WcHl2N2JLM0R1anFLQkxRcDUxWXMxWnNYenFSN20wREdUdmNtaWVNaVpVRl9HbDVuMTIxUHk5X05VcTN6QVBwQTdVNmVaTjMyeG9VUE1ENGh3ZGQtUmpSaUU0bC1SSURkTkFVZ0pUY2xtUktyMk5yc0VUMzdYbEo?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>, [Qazinform](https://news.google.?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>, [UC Today](https://news.google.?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>, [Startup Fortune](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxPTHVDSDVMR0tCN1RLQUlhRWxWYVVlUzdTM1o5OG45VloyYTRnWVplMVdMczBvMVN2aEZIZnh2b0gtVmMtaDRFeU85YTJJNFBDbjhIN3Jpa0U0VHZvakozN0JDdUl5bnotUDlNbHBLRXMyX3ZLcjZoQ2J3TzlNWU1JNk0zbkpqOHp3eDRabUZsdTBDT2RfSlpvLXR3N3RKcUlvblA4?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>

## AI

### Alibaba launches Qwen3.8-Max AI model challenging U.S. frontier labs
<span class="imp imp-4" title="Importance 4/5" aria-label="Importance 4 of 5"><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i></i></span> Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Max, a 2.4-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model it claims rivals or beats Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 on several benchmarks, intensifying competition among Chinese AI developers.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>2.4 trillion total parameters, ~95 billion activated per token (MoE)</li>
<li>1 million token context window; multimodal (text, image, video)</li>
<li>Outranks Moonshot&#x27;s Kimi K3 on multiple benchmarks</li>
<li>Available via Alibaba Cloud Model Studio and QwenWork globally</li>
<li>Open-weights release plus smaller Qwen3.8-27B checkpoint due next week</li>
</ul>
